sentences.text: Lacticaseibacillus is one of 23 novel genera whose names were proposed when the genus Lactobacillus was reclassified on the basis of whole genome sequences.
Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus has been isolated from human sources, including the stool of a healthy Cameroonian infant in a study that characterised strain PMK4 by whole-genome sequencing.
Another study evaluated the probiotic potential of Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus strain 484, isolated from human breast milk, using phenotypic and genomic analyses.
An in vitro study compared inhibition of Streptococcus mutans by infant formula supplemented with the Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG probiotic against a plain formulation.
